title: Wind, slope, and the want of a tail: a computational feasibility study of Eilmer of Malmesbury's flight
description: Analysis code and LaTeX manuscript for a feasibility study of the eleventh-century flight of Eilmer of Malmesbury. The pipeline reconstructs the launch terrain, builds a wind climatology from ERA5 reanalysis, estimates ridge lift, integrates a standing-launch glide on two flight tracks, analyses pitch stability, runs a Monte Carlo over the unknown apparatus and launch day, and models the impact on the legs. Version 1.1.0 corrects the glide model of 1.0.0, which omitted the headwind from the ground speed and assumed the craft started at gliding speed; its results supersede those of 1.0.0.
